title: AIに、小さな開発手順を渡す

source.what_it_is: A collection of Markdown engineering process instructions that an AI reads, organized by development phase. Not a model, API, automatic pipeline or seven autonomous agents. using-agent-skills is a map for choosing a process; this case chose seven instructions and used them partially (no human spec/plan/stage approval, no interview, no refactor step).
source.bundles_note: The three bundles 決める (spec+plan), 進める (incremental+TDD), 確かめる (review+frontend) under the route map are an explanatory grouping for this film, not an upstream schema.

sizes.composition: rail/title/sub at top, diagram world 700x1026 at y=206 using the tall concept layout (library band, request/AI/SPEC row, challenge/Node/cards row, papers/function/returned row, scope/JSON/desk row), foot line at y=1256
title/sub left, rail right, diagram world 1240x576 at y=112 using the separate wide concept layout (three rows of four columns), foot line at y=706

assets.original_function_calls: tasks.mjs and baseline/tasks.mjs are imported and selectTasks is called once after the 32-file gate, with the validated seed.json and the 3 saved option objects; ordered IDs must equal results.json and the returned objects must be the same references as the seed objects. The film draws the objects returned for due-open. No call per frame, no Node test run, no AI inference.

persistent_shapes: library: route book 選び方の地図 (using-agent-skills) above three explanatory bundles 決める/進める/確かめる with six books 仕様・計画・増分・テスト・点検・画面; large with vertical spine names and one-line contents in 0-4 s, then the compact top band
req + old: 依頼（架空） paper with the input.md quote, and 旧TODO paper (状態だけで絞る)
ai: one dark workbench AIが書く with a line naming what is being written; represents the separate original Opus 5.5 runs, never a Node runner
spec: SPEC.md paper whose six area tiles (目的・コマンド・構成・書き方・テスト・境界) open one by one
gate: dashed outlined tag 人の承認なし on the SPEC -> cards line; never a pass mark
cards: two increment cards that emerge from SPEC; each keeps an empty plan checkbox; a green CLI stamp appears only after its GREEN; dashed tag 画面の確認は全増分の後
node: Node station run by the production owner; one badge (既存/RED/GREEN with words and numbers) and two tabs 増分1/増分2; test and minimal-change papers travel AI -> Node, results return red or green
chal: boundary challenge box with the comparison sign (<= / <) and a 14-15-16 calendar line; the day-of point 15 drops out while flipped; badges 1件失敗 then 戻して5件成功; one review chip 5軸点検 必須0
papers: the same six dated TODO papers from seed.json in input order (date stamp, dashed なし for undated, strike-through for done)
fn: selectTasks with a calendar date box (10/15, 当日含む) AND a status chip (未完了だけ)
kept: the papers returned by the original selectTasks, moved physically from their input slots, in input order, stamped violet; excluded papers stay with reason tags 期限後/期限なし/完了
json + desk: outputs/due-open.json with bytes, and the original TODO screen (desk.html)
scope: dashed note that the request and data are fictional and no AI or Node runs here

scenes.title: 工程別の手順を、AIが読む
scenes.sub: Agent Skills から7つ・3つの束は説明のための分け方
scenes.conveys: The skill is a phase-organized collection of process instructions for an AI. The route map chooses; this case picked six books in three explanatory bundles. Contents, not results.
scenes.incoming: Empty frame; camera fitted on the large library that fills the world.
scenes.events: Route book then six books appear one by one (0.3-2.6 s) with vertical spine names, an icon and a one-line contents note each.
scenes.outgoing: Library shrinks into the compact top band while the camera pulls back (3.3-4.0 s).

scenes.title: 依頼と旧TODOから、先に仕様
scenes.sub: 仕様6領域 → 2枚の増分。人の承認はしていない
scenes.conveys: The same fictional request and old TODO enter the AI workbench with the instructions. The AI writes SPEC.md first (six areas), then a plan of two increments. The upstream human approval gate exists but was not performed; shown as an outlined tag, no human interaction drawn.
scenes.incoming: Request and old-TODO papers and the AI workbench appear (4.0-4.8 s); input lines draw (4.6-5.1 s) and flow (5.0-5.6 s).
scenes.events: SPEC.md appears (5.3-5.7 s); six area tiles open (5.7-6.5 s); two cards emerge from SPEC and travel to their slots (6.6-7.4 s); gate tag 人の承認なし (7.1-7.6 s).
scenes.outgoing: Input flows fade (7.6-8.2 s); camera moves to AI/SPEC/Node/cards (7.6-8.3 s).

scenes.title: 増分1：失敗を見てから通す
scenes.sub: Nodeは制作担当：4件中 失敗1 → 最小の変更 → 4件成功
scenes.conveys: Card 1 goes back to the AI; the same test paper travels to the separate Node station run by the production owner: RED 4 tests / 1 fail, then the AI's minimal change, then GREEN 4/4. The AI is never drawn running Node.
scenes.incoming: Node station with the baseline badge 既存 成功3 全3件 (8.0-8.5 s); loop lines (8.2-8.8 s).
scenes.events: Cycle 1 over 8.8-12.6 s: card->AI flow, test paper to Node, RED with red return line, minimal-change paper, GREEN with green return line, CLI stamp on card 1.

scenes.title: 増分2：実在する日付だけ
scenes.sub: 5件中 失敗1 → 5件成功。CLIで確認、画面は全増分の後
scenes.conveys: Card 2 (invalid calendar dates rejected) runs the same loop: RED 5/1 fail, GREEN 5/5. Both cards are marked complete for CLI only; the browser check came after all increments. Plan checkboxes stay empty.
scenes.events: Cycle 2 over 13.0-16.8 s; CLI stamp on card 2; tag 画面の確認は全増分の後 (16.9-17.4 s).

scenes.title: 境界を反転して、見抜けるか
scenes.sub: <= を < にすると1件失敗、戻すと5件成功（記録）
scenes.conveys: The preserved boundary challenge: the original production owner flipped task.dueDate <= cutoff to <, the day-of date leaves the included range and the real Node suite failed 1 test; the byte backup was restored and 5 passed. This shows detection of the tested boundary, not general quality. One separate AI parent review over five axes (required 0, critical 0) is a single inspection step, not five reviewers and not human approval.
scenes.incoming: Challenge box with line from Node (18.2-18.7 s).
scenes.events: Over 19.0-21.4 s: sign flips to < (red), point 15 drops out, badge 1件失敗; sign restores to <=, point 15 back in, badge 戻して5件成功. Review chip 5軸点検 必須0 (21.5-22.2 s).
scenes.outgoing: Node->challenge flow fades (22.4-23.0 s); camera moves to the use area (22.6-23.3 s).

scenes.title: 同じ6枚を、元の関数に通す
scenes.sub: 未完了・10/15まで → 2枚（旧関数 4枚）・due-open.json 926 B
scenes.conveys: The original preserved selectTasks becomes usable: the same six dated papers pass the inclusive civil-date gate AND the status gate; the two objects it actually returned at page load (proposal 10/14, sample 10/15) move to the right in input order. 10/16, undated and done papers stay with reason tags. No date sorting. Linked to the saved 926 B JSON and the original TODO screen.
scenes.incoming: Six papers and the function (23.0-23.6 s); calendar 10/15 and status chip (23.5-24.1 s); input line (23.8-24.2 s).
scenes.events: Papers travel to the function mouth one by one (24.3-26.5 s); returned papers continue to the right slots, the others nudge and return with reason tags; header 返った紙 2枚; JSON and desk join (26.6-27.6 s); scope note (27.2-27.7 s).

scenes.title: AIに、小さな開発手順を渡す
scenes.sub: 手順集 → 仕様と増分 → AIとNode → 反転 → 使える結果
scenes.conveys: Stable whole path, understandable without sound.
scenes.incoming: All edges flow-coloured and emphasis back to full (28.3-28.9 s); camera to the whole diagram (28.2-28.9 s); title and rail switch 28.5-28.9 s.
scenes.events: None. Still from 28.9 s to 32 s; poster at 31 s. No cursor or blinking element.

quoted_values_source: Counts (6 areas, 11 assumptions, 3 -> 4 -> 5 tests, RED fail 1, mutation 1 failure and 5 restored passes, review required 0 / critical 0), labels, the request quote, file name and bytes are read at runtime from validated assets. Returned papers are the objects returned by the original tasks.mjs for due-open; the old-function count is the length returned by baseline/tasks.mjs.

scope.original_production: Original Opus 5.5 authoring in separate runs (receipts: spec, red1, green1, red2, green2, site; no separate plan receipt), 5 Node v24.18.0 runs by the production owner (baseline + 4), 2 increments each CLI-checked and committed, browser check after all increments, 36 separate acceptance checks in Asia/Tokyo, Pacific/Kiritimati and America/Los_Angeles with the same outcomes, the <= -> < mutation (1 failure, restored, 5 passed) and one Codex parent five-axis review (required 0, critical 0). All preserved; none rerun for this revision.
scope.parent_packaging: concept/structure.json, concept/manifest.json and outputs/*.json (UTF-8/LF repackaging of the same saved results.samples objects), desk.html and video/legacy.html archives.
scope.new_authoring: This revision's diagram, motion, controls and Japanese copy (index.html, concept.css, concept.js, video/index.html, video/video.css, video/video.js, video/storyboard.json, video/README.md), written by claude-opus-5-5.
scope.limits: No human spec/plan/stage approval, no interview, no refactor step, plan checkboxes intentionally unchecked, timezone checks are not a general timezone or performance guarantee, the review did not cover the guide, the films or this new UI.
